findings.title: Complete operation belongs in the library
findings.proposal: Ship planning/preparation/publication reconciliation/continuity/cleanup coordination and observable results through narrow consumer primitives.
findings.guardrail: Consumer business code must not recreate orchestration or recovery.

findings.title: Public call/custody mechanism remains unresolved
findings.proposal: Qualify an official existing mechanism for the supported profile; assess existing GM candidate before alternatives.
findings.guardrail: No copying, deep import, incidental rename, fake public-release claim or mandatory consumer counter implementation.

findings.title: Resources cleanup differs from call/custody/physical stop
findings.proposal: Project native cleanup outcomes and retain original native ownership; separate call and continuation lifetime.
findings.guardrail: A complete callback report, released lease, aborted signal and physical stop are not interchangeable.

findings.title: ADR0030 supersedes withdrawn ADR0028 gate
findings.proposal: Use the surviving owning-source qualification path, preserve historical accepted bytes.
findings.guardrail: Withdrawal does not publish the private kernel; do not revive K1 or two-production-scope eligibility as current.

findings.title: One canonical head and product authority
findings.proposal: Library attempt records reference real authority outcomes and lifetime identities.
findings.guardrail: No independently advancing head, grant database or shadow generation registry.

findings.title: Atomic selection/admission/custody boundary
findings.proposal: A supported adapter must preserve exact cohort admission and retention across await and stream continuation.
findings.guardrail: Read-head-then-retain is not sufficient; no default Q5 policy adopted.

findings.title: Explicit unknown publication and recovery
findings.proposal: Reconcile original attempt before retry/destructive cleanup; qualify durable recovery only when claimed.
findings.guardrail: Do not map timeout to rejection or force consumer to rebuild recovery.

findings.title: Colocated update-eligibility dossier
findings.proposal: Own inert profile/state/readiness/lifetime/fallback/evidence facts beside each real eligible feature/module declaration.
findings.guardrail: No new generic Plugin SPI, GM schema expansion or universal hot flag.

findings.title: One real module with cohesive features
findings.proposal: Start with operation feature and actual adapters; split planning/observation only when substantive.
findings.guardrail: No package per phase, empty folders or top-level shared/core substitute.

findings.title: Orthogonal profile dimensions
findings.proposal: Separate composition, loader, ABI, placement, resources, UI, delivery and state.
findings.guardrail: MF/NF/Piral/OC/Wasm/Effect are not interchangeable runtime adapters.

findings.title: Visible usefulness and state continuity are separate evidence
findings.proposal: Observe selected versus useful contributions, draft/undo/focus affinity and actual fallback.
findings.guardrail: Do not select Q3/Q4 or claim a version label proves user adoption.

findings.title: Exact registration ownership protects successor
findings.proposal: Require old finalizer compare exact ownership before clearing selected reference.
findings.guardrail: Reference continuity is not whole-cohort atomicity.

findings.title: Native Effect has existing sharing and nonjoining second-close semantics
findings.proposal: Reuse native layer/memo ownership and preserve original finalization result in optional profile.
findings.guardrail: Source evidence is not native execution; no GM consumer peer upgrade or mandatory Effect.

findings.title: New production repository requires full FMS1.1 bootstrap
findings.proposal: Real feature, profile pin, deterministic rejecting fixtures, strict source gates and observed admission evidence.
findings.guardrail: Research packet/private scaffold/package installation is not admission; existing EF FMS pin unchanged.

findings.title: GM integration preserves outer composition imports and single compiler
findings.proposal: Consume public prepared facts; compose narrow values/ports at accepted outer boundary.
findings.guardrail: No shadow resolver, generic registry, group-as-lifecycle-unit or GM imports throughout inner code.

findings.title: Optional providers do not leak into ordinary declarations
findings.proposal: Check public declaration/runtime closure with disposable packed consumers.
findings.guardrail: No mandatory DOM/Node/Effect/Wasm/EF catalog dependency.

findings.title: Published tooling is distinct from eligible executed bootstrap cohort
findings.proposal: Qualify exact current released dependencies and central recognition; root retains release/cohort evidence.
findings.guardrail: No automatic Foundation3.1 adoption or blind1.7 downgrade; older development catalog not authority.

findings.title: Current EF map has no active withdrawn-gate assertion
findings.proposal: Clarify blueprint combined Resources/lifecycle row and add dated route if useful.
findings.guardrail: Do not manufacture a correction or rewrite historical report/evidence.

findings.title: Foundation validates owned data and contracts only
findings.proposal: Reuse existing optional executable-specification/source graph/profile checks; add capability only for demonstrated gap.
findings.guardrail: No runtime supervisor, business eligibility inference or every-module-hot certification.

findings.title: Q1-Q7 all remain open
findings.proposal: Design seams and explicit profile limitations; resolve owner policies before corresponding production promises.
findings.guardrail: Experimental fixture scope is not adoption.

findings.title: Existing sizing remains bounded research estimate
findings.proposal: Retain 3-6k/7-14k/15-30k authored production SLOC scenarios with separate tests/integration and scoped assumptions.
findings.guardrail: No size escalation from diagram boxes or claim of measured production readiness.

findings.title: Optional native drivers share decision and receipt semantics
findings.proposal: Ordinary TS and optional native Effect retain their own execution semantics while technical transition decisions and receipt interpretation have one owner. Defer interpreter abstraction until a real native consumer.
findings.guardrail: No mandatory Effect core behind Promise facade, no second independently authored transition policy and no speculative universal effect framework.

findings.title: Patterns mapped to owners and negative examples
findings.proposal: Map typed transitions/state-machine option, ports/adapters, expected-head CAS, same-attempt reconciliation, native custody, projections and real anti-corruption boundaries to existing owners.
findings.guardrail: No framework selection, workflow DSL or duplicate general mechanism.

findings.title: Attempt scope does not capture unregistered top-level effects
findings.proposal: A cooperative TS profile qualifies owned effect paths and names unsupported effects; require the actual isolation profile where its trust guarantee is needed.
findings.guardrail: No false containment from surrounding an arbitrary import with a scope; Q1 stays open.
